items.name: email-draft
items.title: Email Draft
items.description: Draft an email or message that gets the reply it needs: purpose in the first line, the ask made explicit with a date, context kept to what the reader needs, one request per message, a subject line that says the content, and a register matched to the relationship (supervisor, colleague, maintainer, support, recruiter). Never sends. Use when writing to a supervisor, a maintainer, a reviewer, a vendor, or a team, when a message is not getting answered, or when a difficult message needs the right tone.
items.author: Khaled Saeed
